About This Game

🔎

Re:Blade is an incremental action game in which you control the sword directly with your mouse.

Move the mouse and the sword follows. When it touches an enemy, it attacks automatically—no need to mash an attack button.

🔎

Choose one of the Awakening effects offered during combat.

The effect you choose changes how your sword attacks and how it develops.

🔎

Use rewards earned in combat to upgrade your sword.

Keep upgrading it to take on stronger enemies and bosses.

🔎

Once your sword is strong enough, enter the Raid.

Defeat the boss and move on to the next battle.

READ MORE

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Re:Blade is a fast-paced action roguelike focused on dynamic combat.
It contains stylized fantasy violence as players fight and defeat enemies.
There is no blood, gore, or realistic violence.
The game has no sexual content, nudity, profanity, drugs, or any other mature themes.
